host_surface_record.truth_rule: Populate only provider-supplied or safely observed fields. Omit or label unknown values; do not infer versions from marketing names, opaque identifiers, or installation paths.

surface_identity_rule: host_family is stable normalization; surface_id identifies an actual binding. Generic kernel packets consume normalized records and do not depend on vendor marketing names.

object_kinds.host_attachment: Host-supplied attachment identity; no filesystem path is invented.
object_kinds.filesystem_object: Object addressable through a host-exposed filesystem scope.
object_kinds.external_source_object: Object retrieved through a connected provider, plugin, app, MCP server, or source service.

source_context_mapping.partial_rule: Partial retrieval remains labeled partial; search-result metadata is not full source content.

network_rule: Web/search, arbitrary outbound networking, and MCP/app/plugin calls are distinct capabilities and must carry separate scope, approval, sandbox, provider, and receipt evidence.
git_rule: Local repository or commit capability never implies remote, push, or PR capability. Git is not a generic kernel requirement.
time_rule: Deployment date context is not exact current time. Exact time requires a provider result with timestamp, timezone/offset, provider, observed_at, and receipt.
scheduling_rule: Natural-language intent or a background-process assumption is not scheduling. Create/update/cancel/recurrence success requires IF-SCHEDULING-PROVIDER capability and a provider schedule receipt.
continuity_rule: Conversation/thread identity may assist correlation but is not security-grade host_session binding. host_session is not durable_external continuity.
